summary: Iter 619 (Booking Engine Conversion Pack — Paket 1) tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (price-calendar, public/admin rate-plans CRUD, flex-dates, reserve-multi + child booking + 422/404 edge cases, regression property/rooms). Frontend public /book?property=aldgate-flats&lang=tr: price calendar (2 months, 61 days, £ prices, click sets check-in/out, '2 gece' Turkish hint, prev/next nav) OK; rate-plan rows for all 3 codes visible with correct totals (flex=£178, non_refundable=£160 (=10% off), breakfast=£208 (+£15/night)); cart with 2 lines from 2 different rooms works, cart-total sums correctly (£446), continue → guest-details → complete-booking-btn (Pay at Hotel) → confirmation-step with booking-ref and both cart line items. Admin (Pro nav → Direct Booking → Booking engine v2 → Fiyat Planları): rate-plans-card + rp-row-flexible/non_refundable/breakfast + rp-add-btn opens rate-plan-form, save shows toast, rp-delete-custom removes row.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique "key" prop' when rendering rate plan rows.

issues: Button label 'Başka Oda Ayırt' appears to be a Turkish typo — likely should be 'Başka Oda Ayır' (imperative of 'ayırmak' = to reserve). Not blocking.

Turkish word 'Devam' (as in 'Devam Et') not found on initial widget page — appears only on the guest-details step which was reached; not a bug, translations verified for 'Müsait', 'Rezervasyon Özeti', '2 gece'.

action_items: Add unique key prop to rate plan row list in /app/frontend/src/components/dashboard/RatePlansCard.js (map should key by plan.id or plan.code).
(Optional) Fix Turkish label 'Başka Oda Ayırt' → 'Başka Oda Ayır' in translations.
critical_code_review_comments: be_conversion.py reserve-multi: math verified (89 × 2 nights = 178 for flexible, 89 × 0.9 × 2 rooms × 2 nights = 320.4 for non_refundable, total 498.4 for the test payload). Endpoint returns cart_master flag on master booking and creates one Booking doc per line with shared cart_ref — clean.
be_conversion.py _plans auto-seeds default plans if none exist per property — idempotent-friendly but seeding is triggered by any GET which could seed for non-target properties. Acceptable for MVP.
RatePlansCard.js missing React key on mapped rows (warning above).
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 1 test rate plan 'TEST_QA_Plan' via API and 'QA Plan' via UI (both deleted). Created ~3 confirmed cart bookings via API and 1 via UI with guest 'TEST QA' at aldgate-flats (not cleaned; optional per request).
